notablePrerequisites: Case of the Pilfered Proof has been solved.
description:
Cause a noncreature Clue to enter the battlefield under your control, which will be an Equipment due to Armed with Proof if it isn't an Equipment already, causing Chishiro to trigger.
Resolve Chishiro's first ability, creating a 2/2 red Spirit creature token with menace plus creating an additional Clue token through Case of the Pilfered Proof (which will be an Equipment due to Armed with Proof), causing Chishiro to trigger.
Repeat from step 2.
